A '''brownie''' is a [[chocolate]] meal that heals {{Hp|6}} and grants {{EffectLink|Haste}} II for 2 minutes 30 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/brownie.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
2 chocolate, sugar and dough. Obtaining chocolate unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating a brownie takes 1.6 seconds, heals {{Hp|6}} and gives Haste II for 2:30.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].
